## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins_table <- penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(
    bill_length_avg = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

penguins_table
  ggplot(data = penguins_table,
         mapping = aes(x = species, y = bill_length_avg)) +
    geom_col() +
    labs(
      x = "Species",
      y = "Average Bill Length (mm)",
      title = "Average Bill Length by Penguin Species"
    )
```
